docs.title: Zephyr Harbor Authority
docs.text: The Zephyr Harbor Authority is chaired by Ada Quill since 2024. The harbor handles 1200 vessels a year. It was founded in 1931 by the town of Zephyr.

docs.title: Zephyr local news
docs.text: Ada Quill opened the new north pier in March. The Zephyr Harbor Authority reported record traffic.

docs.title: Quillon Library
docs.text: The Quillon Library holds 48000 books. It was founded in 1902 and is directed by Mira Holt.

docs.title: Quillon visitor guide
docs.text: Mira Holt leads the Quillon Library reading program. The library opens at 9 every morning.

docs.title: Marsh Observatory
docs.text: The Marsh Observatory sits at 2100 metres. It was built in 1967 and is run by Ilya Park.

docs.title: Marsh telescope notes
docs.text: Ilya Park upgraded the Marsh Observatory main telescope in 2019.
